mechanism_narrative: A lower federal funds rate reduces the cost of capital for corporations, leading to higher equity valuations and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 3.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly CPI reading above 195.0 indicates accelerating inflation, prompting the Fed to tighten policy and causing equity sell-offs in the next 20 days.
failure_condition: When CPIAUCSL exceeds 195.0, SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) signals strong consumer demand, driving corporate earnings and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 days.
failure_condition: In periods where both HOUST and RSAFS rise by more than 1.5% month-over-month, SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 40% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: When unemployment exceeds 5.5%, a further rise in UNRATE signals deteriorating labor market conditions, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: When UNRATE is above 5.5%, SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 50% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A rising industrial production index (INDPRO) indicates expanding manufacturing activity, boosting corporate profits and driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO increases by at least 0.5% month-over-month.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in housing starts (HOUST) and quarterly GDP (GDPC1) signals robust economic expansion, leading to higher equity valuations and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 days.
failure_condition: In periods where both HOUST and GDPC1 rise by more than 1.0% and 0.5% respectively, SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 35% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly payroll employment figure below 133,000 (thousands) indicates weak labor market growth, triggering a sell-off in equities and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: When PAYEMS falls below 133,000, SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 50% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts exceed 2,050 thousand units, it signals strong consumer confidence and economic growth, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In periods when HOUST exceeds 2050, SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of cases.
